text:
sara: FYI CI failing on audit-validator: suppressed-errors check. PR #4826. Noticed a new diff in customer-facing audit events where actor field is sometimes omitted and sometimes null.

mike: looking.

eli: I pulled the CI artifact. Reproducer attached. Seems KMS redaction + serializer now emits `actor: null` for masked actors instead of dropping the field. Goldens expect omission.

```diff
- "actor": "user:123"
+ "actor": null
```

audit-bot: audit-validation: golden_compare failed for /goldens/actor_variants.json (hash mismatch). See https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/4826/artifacts

kevin: Is this related to the RBAC change rolled earlier today? @ashley did the role mapping patch touch our audit emission path?

ashley: I only changed role mapping serialization. Not supposed to alter audit payloads, but I did push a tiny serialization tweak (commit abc123) that changed null-handling behavior in our JSON encoder.

sara: Reproducer command: `./scripts/run_audit_validator --golden=goldens/actor_variants.json --sample=ci/samples/actor.json`

eli: Local stack: `AssertionError: expected key 'actor' to be absent but found null` when comparing sample->golden.

mike: Quick options: adjust the validator to accept null==missing (temporary), update goldens to allow null, or fix emitter to drop nulls.

kevin: Prefer fixing the emitter (drop nulls) so events stay stable for customers. Rolling back the tiny serializer tweak is also an option if faster.

ashley: I'll open a revert PR for the serialization tweak and add a normalization step in the emitter to remove null fields before emission.

sara: Also add a CI guard: explicit mismatch error message when null vs omitted; block merges until golden diff reviewed. And add an integration test that runs a sample through KMS redaction to prevent regressions.

audit-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-137 audit-fixture-regression. Owners: ashley, eli.

eli: I'm adding a unit test to my branch that asserts emitter output drops null actor fields. Pushing in ~10m.

mike: :thumbsup: If this hits customers, we should add a note in release notes and coordinate a canary.

ashley: Agree. If revert not fast enough, we'll bump goldens + run canary, then ship patch to normalize. I'll draft the patch release plan.

sara: Thanks folks. Action items: ashley revert + patch, eli add tests, mike run canary once green, update PR checklist with `./scripts/validate_audit_events` step. I'll follow up here when PRs are linked.
